description: This file contains a unit test suite using pytest which tests the `handle_get_run_command` and `create_minimal_project_config` functions from the `universalinit.cli` module. It uses mock objects to simulate the behavior of project initialization and templates for various project types, verifying that correct command strings are generated and outputted.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: A class representing initialization info for a template, including the run tool command.

classes.name: RunTool
classes.description: A class representing the command and working directory for running a project.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: A class responsible for initializing project templates, with a factory for creating templates.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command
methods.description: Function handling retrieving and printing the run command for a specific project type.

methods.name: create_minimal_project_config
methods.description: Function creating a minimal configuration dictionary for a project based on its type.
